svg.title: Copy of RedAlliance_B1: shoot 4, then drive along the side wall to the LOADING ZONE - BLUE alliance
svg.desc: Top view of the 141.35 by 141.35 inch BIOBUZZ field, audience at the bottom, red alliance on the left. Route red_b1 for the BLUE alliance, starting in tile E6, with 6 steps: 1 START at (106.3, 132.1, 90 deg); 2 SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (106.3, 132.1, 65 deg); 3 WAIT 4.5 s; 4 DRIVE path1 reverse tangent to 105.5, 51.3; 5 DRIVE path2 reverse tangent to 129.3, 51.3; 6 PARK at (129.3, 51.3, 180 deg). First tip: we shoot the first tip. Estimated 13.9 s, POLLEN balance -4, up to 28 points for our robot; 5 errors and 2 warnings.

g.title: WARN step 2 [G417] step 2 (SHOOT, the move to its pose): this volley is TIMED (it feeds for 5.0 s whatever happens, it cannot stop when the camera sees the tip) and the HIVE tips with POLLEN 3 of the 4 (3 NECTAR in the cell; a cell tips at 8 POLLEN-equivalents (each POLLEN counts 1, each NECTAR 5/3)), so the last 1 would be launched into a cell that is already tipping down. FIRST's Q&A QA12 lets you add elements to a HIVE that is moving, but G417 allows launching only into an upward-facing CELL and a launch at a rocking HIVE can spoil the tip. Drop launchSeconds() so the volley is gated by the camera (it stops at the tip and keeps the spare), or fire only 3
